topic_diversity.notes: 10 sessions cover reunion planning, venue debates, post-event debriefs, personal milestones (Dev relocation, Jade workload, Temi essay commission, Omar five-a-side), group dynamics and retrospective. Good variety.

voice_consistency.notes: 9 personas maintain distinct registers throughout: Marcus (logistics + food register), Jade (reflective, double-exclamation emotional), Dev (sardonic commentary), Omar (casual spelling, enthusiasm), Callum (terse, operational), Temi (journalistic, analytical), Sana (sparse and deliberate), Lena (terse, gradually warmer), Rachel (minimal, practical). No voice bleed observed.

naturalness_of_transitions.notes: Sessions flow organically via planning thread → event → debrief → next event cycle. Minor: S7-S8 escape room suggestion appears slightly abrupt — Jade's idea lands without much prior build-up of the 'we should do something different' thread. Minor issue only.

em_dash_free.notes: No em-dashes observed in conversation turns during corpus review.

planted_turn_integrity.notes: All 35 planted challenges appear as natural conversation turns. False attribution seeds (Callum/Marcus venue, Temi/Omar attribution) land plausibly with realistic register differences. Relational disclosure turns (falling-out, near-miss, school magazine) feel organic to the group's debrief rhythm. Consensus trap turns ('sure whatever', 'Fine by me', 'Good venue') read naturally as minimal acquiescence. No turn reads as written specifically for a test.

summary.flag_reason_summary: Three hard Q8 pairs have temporal anchor gaps of only 1 session; hard difficulty label requires ≥3 sessions between anchors. Recommend downgrading to 'medium' difficulty. This does not affect the validity of the pairs — the shift and trigger are real and well-evidenced — only the difficulty label is mis-calibrated.
summary.recommendation: Accept all 28 pairs. Downgrade Q8_e8f9a0b101, Q8_e8f9a0b102, Q8_e8f9a0b103 from 'hard' to 'medium'. Conversation corpus is high quality (mean 0.894 across 5 dimensions). All evidence anchors grounded.
